newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Bank Negara borrows for 1-mth deposit at 7.05 pct.
newsitem.headline: Bank Negara borrows for 1-mth deposit at 7.05 pct.

text.p: Bank Negara Malaysia said it intervened in the interbank money market to borrow for a one-month deposit at 7.05 percent.
Bank Negara last intervened in the money market on August 23 for a one-month deposit also at 7.05 percent.
The central bank came in much later than usual into the market after heavy liquidity threatened to pull down rates below its previous support level.
Bank Negara regularly intervenes in the interbank money market to keep a check on liquidity or set interest rates as part of its inflation fighting efforts.
